final_message:
I parsed the `workspace/worker.log` file to extract error entries based on the specified criteria. I focused on log entries with levels of ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL, converting timestamps to UTC format. The message was taken from the last part of each relevant log entry. I also counted the occurrences of each error, including repetitions indicated by the `-- last message repeated N times --` lines.

The resulting JSON file `workspace/errors.json` contains an array of error objects, each with the required fields, and a summary of counts by service. The final structure adheres to the Acme log-triage conventions.
